EcoIndexFormIntro: Enter a website URL to discover it!
EcoIndexFormInputLabel: Enter a website URL to discover the score:
EcoIndexFormInputInvalid: Please enter a complete web page address, for example “https://example.org”
ResultScoreExplainationContent: Environmental performance is represented by a score out of 100 and a grade from A to G (the higher the grade, the better!). Environmental performance is calculated on the basis of 3 technical indicators: weight, complexity and number of page requests.
ResultFootprintExplainationText:
To give you an idea, 1 kg CO2e is equivalent to a journey of around **5 km by car**. A shower uses an average of 6 litres of water per minute.

If your page emits **1,7g CO2e** and uses **2,5cl of water**, that means that for 1000 monthly visitors, the footprint is **1,7kg de CO2e and 25 litres of water** per month – equivalent to a 5.5km car journey and a 4-minute shower.
ResultDetailsCalculationExplainedContent: To calculate the environmental performance of a page, we take several factors into account: the number of elements in the DOM (Document Object Model), the weight of the data transferred and the number of HTTP requests. Find out more about our calculation method.
AnalysisQueueNext: You are next in the queue.
AnalysisQueueWaiting: There are ##POSITION## analyses ahead of yours.
AnalysisQueueWaitingOne: There is 1 analysis ahead of yours.
AnalysisQueueRunning: It's your turn, the analysis is running.
AboutScoreDetails: Your score details show your page score, median, and target to aim for.
EquationEcoIndex: x = one hundred minus one sixth of (three times the DOM quantile + two times the Http quantile + one time the data quantile, in kilobytes}
AnalysisErrorIntro: The analysis could not be completed.
Error400: This URL is unreachable. Check the address (typo, site offline, unknown domain…) and try again.
Error401: This page requires authentication. EcoIndex can only analyze publicly accessible pages.
Error403: Access to this page was denied. The site is probably blocking the analysis (antibot protection or forbidden access). You can try again later, or test another page.
Error403Excluded: This domain is excluded from EcoIndex analyses.
Error422: There is an invalid parameter, check your request.
Error429:
You have reached the limit of ##daily_limit_per_host## calls per day for the domain name ##host##.  
More information on page [How it works](/how-it-works/).
RedirectToLatestResult: Redirecting to the latest result in ##SECONDS## seconds…
Error500: An unexpected error occurred during the analysis. This is usually temporary: please try again in a few moments.
Error502: The URL you provided is not valid. Please check the URL and try again.
Error504: The page you want to test does not respond. Please try again later.
Error520: This resource is not an HTML page (PDF, image, JSON, etc.). EcoIndex can only analyze standard HTML web pages.
Error521: The page could not be analyzed because the server did not return HTTP 200. It may be missing, protected, redirected, or temporarily in error.
NoJSMessage: **Warning**: JavaScript is currently required for the new version of ecoIndex to work ([enable JavaScript in your browser](https://www.enable-javascript.com/)).
RequestDetailsIntro: Here is the HTTP request breakdown for the page: the heaviest resource types, the domains called, and the full list. This helps identify what is weighing on the score.
RequestDetailsBarLabel: Transferred weight breakdown by resource type
BestPracticesIntro: Here is the RWEB best-practices evaluation for this page: what passes, what needs attention, and what fails. This helps prioritize eco-design actions. These best practices were defined by Green IT collective experts.
BestPracticesEmpty: No best practices for this filter.
